Job Summary

PT Multi Farmindo Jaya is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Technical FP (Further Proses) Coordinator. In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating technical processes, managing data related to production efficiency, and supporting the technical and formulation planning teams to ensure high-quality feed production. You will serve as a key liaison between technical operations, quality control, and production planning to optimize efficiency across our Further Proses operations.

Job Responsibilities

* Coordinate and monitor day-to-day technical and formulation planning activities to ensure alignment with production schedules and quality standards.
* Collect, analyze, and maintain accurate technical data, production reports, and raw material utilization records.
* Assist in the implementation and monitoring of feed formulation adjustments as directed by the nutrition and technical teams.
* Collaborate with production, quality assurance, and procurement departments to troubleshoot technical issues and optimize operational workflows.
* Prepare regular reports on production efficiency, technical performance, and cost-control measures for management review.
* Ensure all technical processes comply with the company’s strict quality control standards, food safety regulations, and occupational health and safety (K3) guidelines.

Job Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Animal Husbandry, Animal Nutrition, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in technical coordination, production planning, or quality control, preferably within the feedmill or poultry industry.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using feed formulation or ERP software (e.g., SAP) is highly advantageous.
* Good understanding of feedmill production processes, raw materials, and quality assurance standards.
* Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple tasks under tight deadlines.
